newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hypo-Bank sees clear rise in H1 oper profit.
newsitem.headline: Hypo-Bank sees clear rise in H1 oper profit.

text.p: Germany's Bayerische Hypotheken- und Wechsel-Bank AG said on Wednesday it expected its operating profits to rise significantly in the first half of 1997 and said risk provisions would fall in the full year.
The bank also said it expected a double-digit percentage rise in its commission income this year.
A spokeswoman for the bank made the predictions, confirming remarks attributed to Hypo-Bank chief executive Eberhard Martini in an interview to be released this week by the Boerse Online magazine.
Hypo-Bank suffered an 8.7 percent drop in operating profit after risk provisions to 1.19 billion marks in 1996.
